title: HiderHub
features:
🔥 **HIDER HUB** - Ultimate Mobile & PC Script Hub 🔥

Welcome to **Hider Hub** – a feature-packed, highly optimized script hub built for both mobile executors (Delta, Arceus X, CodeX, Hydrogen, etc.) and PC! Experience a sleek UI, powerful features, and ultra-smooth performance.

---

### ✨ **Key Features:**
🚀 **Main Features:**
* 🏃 **WalkSpeed:** Fully customizable speed modifier (type your own values).
* 🦘 **JumpPower:** Adjustable jump height.
* 👻 **Noclip:** Walk through walls and obstacles effortlessly.
* 👁️ **X-Ray:** See through walls and structures.
* 🟢 **ESP:** Highlights all players in bright green through walls.
* ✈️ **Advanced Fly:** Specially designed for mobile users with dedicated ⬆️ ⬇️ screen buttons for smooth vertical control—no more getting stuck or freezing!

📊 **Player Stats Info:**
* Displays your Display Name and Username clearly.
* Live in-game playtime tracker (Hours:Minutes:Seconds).

🎨 **Visual Effects:**
* 🌈 **Rainbow Skin:** Constantly shift your character's colors.
* 🔥 **Aura Flame:** Add a blazing fire effect around your character.
* 💨 **Smoke:** Equip a cool smoke particle effect.
* 🫥 **Invisible:** Go completely hidden.

🎯 **Server Teleport:**
* Clean, interactive list of all players currently in the server. Click any name to instantly teleport right to them!

---

### 📥 **Loadstring / How to Use:**
```lua
loadstring(game:HttpGet("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kai2251800-cpu/Nulia/refs/heads/main/HiderHub.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kai2251800-cpu/Nulia/refs/heads/main/HiderHub.lua)"))()
